integrity: Proof is analytic; a standalone exact-arithmetic checker verifies only the explicit witness. Publication priority is evaluated within the inspected sources, without a claim of independent review.
scientific_limitations: Bound is for hyperbolic full-planar sinks on the invariant-square boundary when f and g are arbitrary quadratic-or-lower real polynomials; no global basin or interior equilibrium classification. Relevant published result concerns a proper six-parameter subfamily. An equivalent unindexed prior result is possible.
title: Five is the sharp boundary-sink capacity of quartic invariant-square flows
